title: Release Artifact SBOM and SLSA-style Provenance Generation Definition
description: Generation definition for the SBOM and provenance attestation required of every release artifact. This document defines WHAT must be produced; the build workflow that produces it is infra/ci/sbom-provenance.yml.

sbom_required.citation: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §2 supply-chain security: 'Lockfiles, SBOM, provenance, signed images, SAST/SCA/container scanning, protected artifact registry | Release is blocked on defined critical findings or missing provenance.' 02_POLYGLOT_ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md §10: 'Every artifact is built from a locked dependency graph and emits an SBOM, provenance statement, source revision, compiler/runtime identity, configuration schema version, and reproducible artifact digest.' 25_DEEP_ARCHITECTURAL_AUDIT_AND_FULL_SCALE_RELEASE_PROFILE.md §8 item 1 lists SBOM and provenance in the release evidence package.

provenance_required.citation: 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §7 mandatory controls include 'SBOM; signed build provenance; ... artifact digest verification'. 23_ARCHITECTURE_AND_COMPLIANCE_DECISIONS.md §2: 'Terraform-managed, immutable OCI images, signed release artifacts'.

signature_required.citation: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §16 prohibits 'unsigned production artifacts' in the production baseline. 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §6: 'rotate signing keys at least annually and after compromise, with overlapping verification keys during planned rotation.'

reproducibility_required.citation: 02_POLYGLOT_ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md §10: artifacts must have a 'reproducible artifact digest'. 13_IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md: 'the production release can be reproduced from immutable source and artifact digests.'

no_rebuild_between_environments.citation: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §15: 'The release candidate is promoted through validation environments without rebuilding from source between environments.' 09_TESTING_AND_RELEASE_EVIDENCE.md §Release strategy: promotion dev -> test -> staging -> paper -> shadow -> live.

digest_pinned_no_latest.citation: 23_ARCHITECTURE_AND_COMPLIANCE_DECISIONS.md §2: immutable OCI images. 25 §8 item 1 records the artifact digest. Mutable tags and :latest are deny conditions.

must_cover: OS base image and its packages
all direct and transitive dependencies from the committed lockfile

unmaintained_dependency_rule.citation: 18_GOVERNANCE_DATA_AND_COMPLIANCE.md §6: 'Unmaintained or critical-vulnerability dependencies cannot be promoted without remediation or an approved, time-bounded compensating control.' 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §4: 'Unsupported dependencies are prohibited in production.'

critical_vulnerability_rule.citation: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §2: 'Release is blocked on defined critical findings or missing provenance.' 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §7: 'Critical vulnerability remediation target is 24 hours for exploitable internet-facing components and 7 days for other production components.'

end_of_life_runtime_rule.citation: 23_ARCHITECTURE_AND_COMPLIANCE_DECISIONS.md §7: 'End-of-life runtimes are prohibited.' 00_README.md §Toolchain lifecycle: 'Unsupported or end-of-life versions are prohibited.'

provenance.slsa_level: SLSA Build L3 (build provenance is non-falsifiable and independently verifiable)

buildDefinition.citation: SLSA Build provenance: records the source, the build platform, and the fully resolved dependency set.

runDetails.citation: SLSA Build provenance: identifies the builder and the invocation.

must_record.toolchain_versions: 25 §8 item 1: 'toolchain versions'; 23 §7: versions are 'pinned exactly, and recorded in release evidence'.
must_record.configuration_schema_version: 02_POLYGLOT_ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md §10 requires a 'configuration schema version' on every artifact.
must_record.builder_identity: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §2 requires a 'protected artifact registry'; only the protected build identity may publish to the environment registry.

material_parameters: source repository URI and commit digest
build platform identifier (image, toolchain, compiler/runtime versions)
provenance.secret_justification: 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §6: 'Secrets, authentication factors, private keys, and raw access tokens never enter source, logs, prompts, analytics, test fixtures, or client bundles.'

artifact_identity.registry_immutability: tags are write-once; a tag that exists cannot be overwritten
artifact_identity.citation: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §15: 'Production releases use immutable artifacts and progressive deployment'; 23_ARCHITECTURE_AND_COMPLIANCE_DECISIONS.md §2: 'immutable OCI images, signed release artifacts'; 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §7: 'artifact digest verification'.

signing.rotation_citation: 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §6: 'rotate signing keys at least annually and after compromise, with overlapping verification keys during planned rotation.'
signing.checkpoint_citation: 23_ARCHITECTURE_AND_COMPLIANCE_DECISIONS.md §6: 'Audit checkpoint | Daily and on key rotation / high-impact security event.' Every key rotation therefore produces a signed audit checkpoint.

required_before_promotion: provenance attestation generated, signed, and verified
artifact digest recorded and digest-pinned in the deployment manifest
no unresolved critical or high vulnerability finding without an approved time-bounded compensating control
toolchain versions match the pinned versions (no drift)
lockfile digest matches the committed lockfile
promotion_gates.citation: 23_ARCHITECTURE_AND_COMPLIANCE_DECISIONS.md §7: 'CI rejects floating dependencies and toolchain drift.' 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §2: 'Release is blocked on defined critical findings or missing provenance.' 02_POLYGLOT_ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md: 'CI rejects floating dependency versions, uncommitted lockfile changes, and toolchain drift.'
